title: Fabien N NDE 7502
content: When I arrived at the toilet, I had real pain in my stomach. Then I evacuated all the blood that I had been swallowing before with the stools. The blood had even not been digested. After a few moments, I started to feel some tinnitus, becoming ever stronger in my ears. Then I heard buzzing and suddenly my vision became blurred. There was like a black dot spluttering before my eyes and a big black point appeared at the center of my vision. It grew progressively larger until my vision was completely black. At that moment, I heard a sound of bells. My body fell to the ground and I couldn't do anything anymore. I only was aware what happened to me. The nurses came in and started to slap me to awaken me. In the beginning, I still could feel the pain of those slaps. As time passed, the slaps felt like caresses and I didn't feel pain anymore. I heard the voices of the nurses, progressively going away. It was then that a bright white light appeared. Progressively, this light encompassed the whole room in which I was. This light did not blind me. It was a very powerful white light and I had the sensation of being in a fog. I felt good, had no pain at all. I thought, 'this is death? Well, I should have died earlier!!!' Then the white light made room for a slightly pinkish light. The sensation that I felt in that light was even more pleasant than the preceding feeling. At that moment, I felt that my soul detached from my body without detaching completely. I had no desire to get back into my body. All my memories of earthly life seemed like they were being erased. I gradually forgot who I had been, who my family members and friends had been. Finally, I woke up on my bed in hospital after a nurse had been injecting adrenaline into me.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt his soul detach from his body but 'without detaching completely'; had no desire to get back into his body; felt no pain and felt good/pleasant.

environment.environment_other_detail: Powerful white light that encompassed the room; sensation of being 'in a fog'; then a slightly pinkish light.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Woke up in hospital bed after a nurse injected adrenaline.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe gastrointestinal bleeding (evacuated blood in stools) followed by collapse; resuscitation included adrenaline injection.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also described auditory phenomena (tinnitus, buzzing, bells), vision narrowing to black, and fading of nurses' voices; progressive memory/identity erasure.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Collapse with fading sensory input, then bright white light filling the room (fog-like), then pinkish light, then partial soul detachment with identity/memory erasure, then return upon adrenaline injection.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Progressive loss/erasure of autobiographical memory and identity during the experience; slaps initially painful then felt like caresses as sensation changed.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "this is death? Well, I should have died earlier!!!"
